description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: A narrow rack has three deep vertical channels and a broad woven front rail. Side: The channels slope backward between stout bamboo dividers. Rear: A closed rear stop and low rear feet prevent boards sliding through. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the canonical FRONT of this exact rattan/bamboo household object. Create ONE corrected rear catalog photo by camera movement only. The camera faces the OUTSIDE BACK of the high flat rectangular bamboo square-lattice back panel. Show one continuous full-height rear lattice backing with rear support posts and rear feet. The three open cutting-board channels and low front guard are on the OPPOSITE side and must be hidden behind this back panel. Do not repeat the three frontal open channels in this rear view. Preserve exact original proportions, color, weave, number and location of all supports, compartments, rods, legs and plain secondary inserts. Previously hidden rear geometry is inferred but must plausibly support this exact object without redesign. Whole product centered on same warm-white seamless studio background, soft light and shadow, no props. NO TEXT, labels, logos, numbers or markings.

visual_review.method: manual comparison of canonical front and three-view review sheet
